static_traits.name: Chen Xinya
static_traits.family_status: Lives with father and brother, has a cat
static_traits.social_status: Rarely going out, very little social interaction, Limited social support (mainly from family and pet companionship), often Feels isolated
static_traits.medical_history: Previously experienced depression and Anxiety multiple times during Social isolation periods; has not yet received formal psychotherapy or counseling; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; attitude leaning negative, tending toward self-reproach and negation; reserved about cognitive exploration but willing to try; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Long-term experience of depression and Anxiety, tending to attribute it to oneself 'being a bad person', persistent Self-blame and guilt, leading to impaired functioning and Decreased quality of life.
basic_info.core_demands: When I realized depression and Anxiety were significantly affecting my quality of life and hindering me from making positive changes, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: In multiple past stages, depression and Anxiety repeatedly appeared due to Social isolation and lack of interaction; never received formal psychotherapy; life support mainly came from living with Father, brothers, and pet companionship. Over time, negative emotions and self-blame worsened, gradually affecting Work performance, routine and motivation.

core_beliefs: I am not strong enough, not capable enough

special_situations.event: Arranged to go out with friends but cancelled at the last moment, afterwards repeatedly blames oneself alone at home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot fulfill social commitments as planned, it shows I am an unreliable, disappointing person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raising standards for oneself, harsh self-criticism; Avoids socializing to avoid being judged by others again or disappointing others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed my friend; I am a bad friend; it is my fault

special_situations.event: When alone at home, rarely going out, socially isolated, negative emotions and self-blame appear daily
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot go out and maintain normal socializing as I 'should', it shows I am essentially flawed, a not-good-enough person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing outings and staying at home continuously, to avoid facing social Anxiety and possible failure; using self-blame to drive oneself to 'be better'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every day is a terrible day, I will never get better, this It is all my fault

special_situations.event: When work performance is affected and it is hard to maintain previous levels
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work performance cannot reach high standards or perfection, it equals failure, showing I am not capable enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting rigid high standards for oneself and negating any imperfect performance, driving oneself with reproach and shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not competent, I am just a failure

special_situations.event: When considering lowering expectations of oneself or using more compassionate self-talk
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I lower standards or am lenient with myself, it means I am not good enough, making excuses
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Insists on 'should/must' self-demands, refuses more balanced views in order to maintain a sense of control over self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just making excuses for myself; I should be able to do better

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, proving she is not a 'bad person' and is someone of worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing one's essence is flawed, will disappoint others and face negation or rejection
defense_goal: Maintains distance to reduce the risk of being judged and disappointing others again
Gains a sense of control over self-worth through self-reproach and high standards

object_relations.self_representation: I am flawed and easily disappoint others
object_relations.object_representation: Others are critical judges who will think me unreliable

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to examine negative thoughts or do cognitive restructuring
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing exploring thoughts is 'useless', insisting 'this is just my feeling', thereby denying possible change at the cognitive level
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a flat and defensive tone, such as 'this is useless' 'looking at thoughts changes nothing', avoiding elaborating facts; quickly returning to emotional statements and shortening the conversation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes viewing oneself by more balanced standards, reducing self-blame, or trying self-compassion
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding empathy and acceptance as 'making excuses', continuing self-reproach with high-standard Rationalization
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using 'I should/must' type statements, emphasizing principles and standards, tone firm and defensive; dismissing suggestions with 'this is just excusing myself', keeping distance.

manifestations: Rarely goes out, very little social interaction, often alone at home
Limited social support, mainly relying on family and pet companionship
In isolation, negative emotions and self-blame intensify markedly
outcomes: Work and daily routine affected, Decreased drive

manifestations: Subjectively experiences 'every day is a bad day', finding it hard to see the positive side
Lacking hope for change, believing cognitive adjustment is 'useless'
outcomes: Increased sense of despair and negative expectations
Behaviorally more avoidant, further weakening functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently using 'should/must' Demands on oneself: such as 'I should be able to handle things better'
Understanding lowering standards as 'not good enough' or 'making excuses', rejecting more balanced self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Blaming oneself entirely for depression and Anxiety: 'It is my fault, because I am a bad person'
Over-focusing on inadequacies and flaws, negating one's own worth and efforts

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: Believing friends will see oneself as 'unreliable/breaking appointments', presupposing others' negative evaluations
Preemptively assumes others' disappointment in social events, thereby intensifying avoidance

positive_force: Actively seeks counseling, willing to try change (though with reservations, still says 'can give it a try')
Once independently tried journaling and relaxation exercises; has a degree of self-help willingness and behavior
Has family companionship and a pet providing emotional support
negative_force: Long-term Social isolation and rarely going out, Reinforcing Loneliness and avoidance
Strong self-labeling and self-blame (attributing depression and Anxiety to 'I am a bad person')
Rigid high standards and 'should/must' beliefs lead to persistent guilt and shame
Cognitive distortions such as emotional reasoning, catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and personalization are prominent
Limited Social support system, insufficient external resources

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and last-minute cancellation of appointments
antecedent: When having plans with friends requiring going out or social interaction
Thinking about possibly disappointing others or being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being judged and disappointing others, and the cognitive assumption that 'if not perfect then failure'
target_behavior.function: Escaping social pressure and potential negative evaluation, relieving Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Strong Guilt and self-blame afterwards, Interpersonal relationships damaged, isolation worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent depression and Anxiety experience (emotional symptoms)
antecedent: When home alone and lacking social contact
Repeatedly dwelling on one's flaws and failures
When work or life task loads increase
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs (I am a bad person/It is all my fault) and multiple cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization, etc.) activated in isolated situations
target_behavior.function: Avoids external demands and interactions by immersing in negative emotions, maintaining a 'sense of control' over self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Life functioning declines, sleep and motivation impaired, problems continue to worsen

target_behavior.behavior: Verbal behavior of harsh self-blame and negative self-labeling
antecedent: When Decline in work performance or not yet reaching self-set high standards
When discussions involve adjusting expectations or self-compassion
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigid 'should/must' rules and a black-and-white evaluation system, trying to drive change through self-blame
target_behavior.function: Maintains inner order and a sense of standards, trying to gain motivation for improvement (superficial self-restraint)
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening depression and Anxiety, negating positive aspects, weakening actual action and possibility of improvement
